principle: Scenario features are evaluated as pre-race race-shape information. They are not promoted to final horse probability corrections unless they improve forward OOS performance.

queue_front_back.summary: Gate, first-turn distance and front competition improve continuous first-corner front-back position accuracy beyond horse history alone in 2024, 2025 and 2026 OOS.

lateral_lane.summary: Historical source contains corner order but not measured rail/path width. Inner/middle/outer lane is therefore a heuristic based on gate, early speed and distance to first turn, not an empirically validated lane prediction.

pace.summary: Race-composition pace model improves MAE directionally versus course historical mean in all three OOS years, but race-bootstrap confidence intervals cross zero.

pace_mismatch_horse_probability.summary: Using mismatch between predicted race pace and a horse's recent experienced RPCI range as a top-3 probability correction is not robust. It improved 2025 slightly but worsened 2026 and the 2026 race-bootstrap interval was above zero.

deployment_policy.queue_front_back: Use in the visual race map and scenario narrative when at least two prior valid corner runs are available.
deployment_policy.pace_mismatch: Display as a caution note only; do not downgrade calibrated win/top2/top3 probabilities.
